name: dsh-runinfra-autosync
description: DSH host plugin: reconcile the 'runinfra' llm-pi-ai route's model list against the live RunInfra /v1/models listing. Runs once at dsh startup and again on an interval; keeps existing configured entries (compat/reasoningEfforts/capacity) for ids still advertised, appends newly listed ids with RunInfra-safe defaults, and drops ids the gateway no longer lists. Unlike dsh-opencode-autosync (add-only), RunInfra is a single-protocol gateway whose /v1/models list is authoritative, so this plugin prunes models that fall off the live list.
